US envoys Witkoff and Kushner are shuttling between Moscow and Kyiv with "new ideas" but Ukraine peace prospects remain fragile as winter approaches. A survivor was rescued from a Nepal glacier collapse. Swiss researchers are trialing wool blankets to slow Alpine glacier melt. Horse smuggling across the Rio Grande raises biosecurity concerns over screwworm spread into the US.
